description_en: Retrieves the total communication duration for an application within a specified time range. Data is aggregated by audio and video specifications
description_zh: 获取应用在一段时间内按照音视频规格进行统计的累计通信时长
kebab_example: aliyun rtc describe-rtc-duration-data --start-time 2020-02-04T05:00:00Z --end-time 2020-02-04T07:00:00Z --app-id yourAppId --service-area CN --interval 3600 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeRtcDurationData

parameters.help_en: The start of the time range to query. Specify the time in UTC format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ
parameters.help_zh: 查询数据起始时间，UTC格式，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en:
The end of the time range to query. Specify the time in UTC format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ.

The end time must be later than the start time
parameters.help_zh:
查询数据结束时间，UTC格式，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ。

结束时间需大于起始时间
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the application. You can specify only one ID.

If you leave this parameter empty, data for all your applications is returned
parameters.help_zh:
应用ID，仅支持传单个ID。

默认查询所有应用ID。
parameters.name: app_id

parameters.help_en: The area where the service is deployed. The default value is CN, which indicates China
parameters.name: service_area

parameters.help_en:
The time granularity of the query, in seconds.

Valid values are 3600 (1 hour) and 86400 (1 day). The default value is 3600
parameters.help_zh:
查询数据的时间粒度，单位：秒。

取值为3600（1小时）或86400（1天），默认为3600。
parameters.name: interval

AudioDuration.description_en: The duration of audio-only communication, in minutes
AudioDuration.description_zh: 纯音频通信时长，单位：分钟

ContentDuration.description_en: The duration of screen sharing, in minutes
ContentDuration.description_zh: 屏幕共享时长，单位：分钟

TimeStamp.description_en: The timestamp of the data record. The time is in UTC and the format is yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ

TotalDuration.description_en: The total communication duration, in minutes

V1080Duration.description_en: The duration of communication in Full HD (video resolution of 1920x1080 or lower), in minutes
V1080Duration.description_zh: 全高清通信时长，视频分辨率为1920X1080及以下，单位：分钟

V360Duration.description_en: The duration of communication in SD (video resolution of 640x480 or lower), in minutes
V360Duration.description_zh: 标清通信时长，视频分辨率为640X480及以下，单位：分钟

V720Duration.description_en: The duration of communication in HD (video resolution of 1280x720 or lower), in minutes
V720Duration.description_zh: 高清通信时长，视频分辨率为1280X720及以下，单位：分钟
